title: Media Buy Status
description: Status of a media buy. Status is the buyer-actionable readiness axis; seller commitment is the independent `confirmed_at` field. A buy with `confirmed_at: null` is never `active`.

enumDescriptions.pending_creatives: **Buyer-side action required.** The media buy exists but its creative requirement is unmet: no creatives are assigned, or the assigned creatives have not yet been approved for every package. The buyer must supply or correct creatives (for example via `sync_creatives`) before the buy can serve. This status is a buyer-actionable readiness axis, not a record of seller commitment: whether the seller has committed to the buy is the independent `confirmed_at` axis, and commitment is keyed off `confirmed_at`, never off `status`. A provisional buy (`confirmed_at: null`) reports the status it will have on confirmation: `pending_creatives` while creatives are missing or unapproved, `pending_start` once the buy is otherwise ready. Neither value says the seller has approved or accepted the buy. Naming convention: `pending_X` names the lifecycle phase that is next required (here, `creatives`), not a state of waiting on seller or operator review, consistent with `pending_start` (waiting for the flight date to begin).
enumDescriptions.pending_start: Media buy is ready to serve and waiting for its flight date to begin.
enumDescriptions.active: Media buy is currently running. Reported only for a committed buy: a buy whose `confirmed_at` is null MUST NOT be `active`.
enumDescriptions.rejected: Media buy was declined by the seller after creation
enumDescriptions.canceled: Media buy was terminated before natural completion. Check cancellation.canceled_by to determine whether the buyer or seller initiated.
